description: This Java class 'ProductDisplayWorker' provides utility methods for retrieving related products, quick reorder suggestions, and product ordering logic within the context of an e-commerce shopping cart system, specifically for product display and recommendation features.

classes.name: ProductDisplayWorker
classes.description: Utility class for product display and recommendation logic in shopping cart context, including methods for related product retrieval, quick reorder suggestions, and product ordering.

methods.name: getRandomCartProductAssoc
methods.description: Retrieves a random list of associated products (e.g., cross-sell, complement) related to items in the shopping cart, with optional category view filtering.

methods.name: getQuickReorderProducts
methods.description: Generates a list of products for quick reorder based on user's past orders, considering product quantities and occurrences, with filtering based on current category view.

methods.name: productOrderByMap
methods.description: Sorts a list of products based on a provided mapping of product IDs to comparison values, either ascending or descending.
